annotation.evidence_span: To avoid unbounded alias chains, clients and recursive resolvers MUST impose a limit on the total number of SVCB aliases they will follow for each resolution request.
annotation.interpretation_a: An implementation may choose to allow up to 10 SVCB aliases per request.
annotation.interpretation_b: An implementation may choose to allow up to 5 SVCB aliases per request.
annotation.justification: The clause mandates a limit but does not specify the numeric value, leaving the choice of limit open to implementers. This incomplete constraint allows multiple reasonable implementation behaviours.
